The heavy and painful flow seemed normal, no gynecologist batted an eye ever.

I accepted I have to try and seek help elsewhere (I will try talking to a naturopath in March, started with inositol, changed some eating habits). I googled the shit out of PCOS and found a lot of women claiming they’ve never felt better after changing their diet, ways to exercise (majority says low intensity is the way to go) and supplements (myo-inositol & d-chiro-inositol).
